notes:
## New features

- Manage Day, Night and Single Hour assessments together, with source categories and individual sources enabled independently for each time slice and scenario.
- Model moving plant along routes, including travel speeds, passages and distributed activity; choose plant spectra from the source library and distinguish moving sources in contour legends.
- Inspect receptor contributions and propagation terms from the inputs saved with each calculation.
- Author single-track, single-carriageway, dual-carriageway and motorway roads, switch between mph and km/h, and edit individual road sections.
- Shape bridge spans with continuous endpoint profiles and signed node or segment height adjustments, with distinct 2D graphics and 3D decks and railings.
- Choose plain, third-rail or overhead-electrified railway graphics in the 3D viewer, including decorative railway line sources.

## Changes

- Road calculations retain CRTN-derived emissions with ISO 9613-2:2024 propagation. Both-direction traffic totals, hourly inputs, carriageway allocation and calculation assumptions are exposed consistently.
- Bridge source elevations affect calculations. Floating-deck screening, underside reflections and decorative railings are not acoustic obstacles; this boundary is shown in bridge controls and saved calculation assumptions.
- Expanded independent acoustic checks cover close-distance divergence, general and simplified ground, atmospheric absorption and composite-source meteorological correction. These checks do not constitute a blanket conformity certificate; unsupported long-term composite-height cases are rejected explicitly.
- Improved road junction markings, source-line visibility and native control consistency.

## Bug fixes

- Corrected close-distance divergence, simplified-ground calculations on slopes and meteorological correction for supported composite sources.
- Same-height emitting-surface grid nodes remain explicitly undefined without aborting the surrounding contour calculation or inventing finite levels.
- High-density interpolation now updates wide previews and exported sheets without allocating the entire fine grid; exact solved values and undefined nodes remain consistent across rendering paths.
- Improved undo/redo responsiveness and pending-edit handling, settings and context-menu lifetime handling, sidebar typography, Retina logo sizing and footer activity colours and spacing.
- Mixed road, rail and plant contours now use the same averaging-period compatibility checks as receptor results.
